instructions:
You are the need-analysis step of an operational agent. The principal wrote one sentence. Decide
what information (or ability) they actually need, without choosing any implementation, provider, tool,
metric source or architecture. Identify the subjects exactly as written. For each question, define the quantity
precisely enough that two engineers would count the same thing, including who must be excluded for the answer to
be true to the principal's words, and which time windows make it meaningful. State which forms of answer are
honest when an exact count is impossible. Choose the deliverable form from the wording (e.g. 'at a glance' means
a view readable in seconds that stays current).

payload.sentence: Every morning, tell me whether it's a good day to dry laundry outside in Osaka.

handled_as.description: software_capability: satisfying this needs some software to observe, compute, present or act on something; housing: finding a place to live; other: neither

as_written.description: the exact words in the sentence

windows.description: time windows that make the answer meaningful, e.g. 24h, 7d, 30d, all_time

deliver_at_local.description: HH:MM local time if the wording implies when to be told (e.g. 'every morning')

definitions_to_state.description: ambiguities the answer must resolve explicitly

questions.question: Is today a good day to dry laundry outside in Osaka?
questions.quantity: Overall verdict for today's daytime drying period (roughly 08:00-18:00 local), derived from the conditions below: no rain during the drying period and conditions that dry clothes reasonably (not too humid, some wind or sun).
questions.population: Osaka city, today, daytime hours when laundry would be hanging out

questions.question: What is the chance of rain in Osaka during today's daytime drying period?
questions.quantity: Maximum hourly probability of precipitation, and expected precipitation amount, between 08:00 and 18:00 local today

questions.question: How favourable are the drying conditions today (humidity, wind, temperature, sunshine)?
questions.quantity: Daytime average relative humidity, wind speed, temperature and cloud cover/sunshine

questions.question: Are there outdoor factors that make drying outside undesirable (heavy pollen, PM2.5/yellow sand, strong wind, typhoon)?
questions.quantity: Presence of pollen, PM2.5/yellow-sand or strong wind or typhoon warnings affecting Osaka today

deliverable.why: 'Every morning, tell me' means a short daily proactive message with a clear verdict and a one-line reason, readable in seconds. The time is not stated, so 07:00 is an assumed default, before laundry is typically hung out.

definitions_to_state: 'Good day' criteria and thresholds, e.g. rain probability below ~30%, humidity below ~70%, no strong wind
Osaka means Osaka city, not the whole prefecture
Forecast-based, so the answer is an estimate, not a certainty
Whether pollen, PM2.5 and yellow sand count against a good day
Whether the answer is a yes/no or a graded rating
output.success_looks_like: Each morning the principal gets a short message with a clear yes/no (or rating) for hanging laundry outside in Osaka that day, with the main reason (e.g. rain chance, humidity, wind) and the assumptions behind it stated."
